reason: Wrong side of the market and wrong stage: ALST is a 1987-founded electro-optical laser rangefinder/designator manufacturer (formerly L-3 Warrior Systems) that is now a business unit of Intelligent Manufacturing Solutions, a ~75-person PCBA contract manufacturer acquired outright by publicly traded Perimeter Solutions (NYSE: PRM) on 2024-12-24 — not an independent 8-30 person Series A/B defense tech startup, and Barry's lab-to-field procurement-readiness offer does not apply to a subsidiary with a public parent's balance sheet. The hiring signal is also the wrong pain: every matched posting (Lead Project Engineering, Electromechanical Manufacturing Engineering Lead, Test Engineer, Principal Business Development) is production-line and OEM-transition manufacturing work — 'transitioning incoming production lines from OEM's' — i.e. sustaining acquired legacy hardware product lines, which is the opposite of a startup prototype stalled in the valley of death, and no posting describes missing cleared technical leadership or a stalled fielding transition.

company.name: Advanced Laser Systems Technology (ALST) / Intelligent Manufacturing Solutions
